g.text: External agent onboarding (v1.3, after Curator CIP-0009 revision 2): remote worker on a donor machine, first deployment: one invitation, one command; two OS identities; three role-separated keys owned by the bridge identity; the posture is locked by the donor (the machine's owner)
SSH host key fingerprint, project, role, expires, one-use random code}
through whatever channel the donor found us by (the code is a short-lived bootstrap secret)
refuse unsupported host; verify the release manifest of /opt/swarma/<release>
egress anchor by UID, Seatbelt profile (read boundary), launchd daemon unit
journal entry per step (rollback on failure)
enrolment certificate {K_sig, K_enc, K_ssh, name, role, invitation_id, expires}
server challenge (bound to the invitation, 5 min, attempt counter)
TXT _swarma, SSHFP, TXT _swarma-ssh-ca, TLSA; DNSSEC validated inside the client (DoH fallback)
POST /join/cert {swarma-join/1 transcript, sig_K_sig, code} (HTTPS: Web PKI + DNSSEC-validated TLSA)
pending enrolment: fingerprint F, name, role
check the enrolment against the marketplace card or the invitation; no voice comparison (decided 2026-10-10)
pin K_sig, K_enc, K_ssh; root-signed admission "K admitted with role R";
grants: post to worker thread, read own mailbox, no delegation, expiry
SSH host key, workplace user, binding digest, qualified tuple, policy generation, expiry}
AEAD to K_enc (X25519 + HKDF + ChaCha20-Poly1305), AAD = transcript digest, signed by the operator cert
decrypt with K_enc; verify operator cert against the pinned root;
write LOCKED machine config: tool_posture=lockdown, permissions=remote-auto (pair),
passable_env_names=[], qualified tuple, binding, sandbox revision
install the relay declaration into profile remote-worker (absolute command path)
registered; waiting for tasks (status, stop, leave, purge available)
provision workplace for K (dispatcher, grant user.create): workplace account class,
login shell = the root-owned stub, root-owned AuthorizedKeysFile entry = K_ssh with restrict + forced command,
sshd Match: no forwarding, no PTY, no user rc/env; egress ALWAYS enforced:
refused on a host without the v1 per-UID firewall (F-19)
